sculpt_barrel_small.author: sculpted for this project
sculpt_barrel_small.notes: Sculpted squat cask (uneven staves, four plaited split-bamboo hoops, paper label with ink stroke + red seal, bung with a straw twist). Vertex colours on every LOD, no textures: batched + rolling prop. Families wood / straw (the hoops; the old metal family is not used).
